policy: ADR 0009 fusion weights; symmetric soft preference for explicit tests; whole-word test intent detection; no architecture or candidate-pool changes
selection: Higher development macro-average top1 and NDCG, no per-question rank or recall regressions across five repositories. Chi v2 labels fixed before tuning.
holdout_acceptance: No per-question recall@5 regressions; aggregate top1 and NDCG@5 must not decline; all requests must use the live Jina mmap path without failures. No tuning after holdout.
